title: BrowseFlow: Sparse Event Flow Matching for Generative User Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2610.41374v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: User simulation aims to reproduce how users interact with content and products across online platforms. Recent generative approaches have enriched user simulation with behavioral history and contextual information. However, realistic browsing simulation still faces two challenges. (i) Stochastic Responses: Even with the same recommendation feed, the same user may produce different browsing responses, yielding distinct behavioral trajectories. A logged trajectory records only one such realization. (ii) Sparse Key Events: Clicks and likes provide important feedback but occur sparsely within browsing trajectories dominated by progression actions such as scrolling. Many stepwise simulators predict these actions in a dense sequence, where key events contribute relatively few training targets. To address these challenges, we propose BrowseFlow, a conditional discrete flow matching method for generative user simulation. For Sparse Key Events, B

translated_title: BrowseFlow：面向生成式用户模拟的稀疏事件流匹配
translated_abstract: 用户模拟旨在重现用户如何与在线平台上的内容和产品进行交互。近期的生成式方法通过引入行为历史和上下文信息丰富了用户模拟。然而，逼真的浏览模拟仍然面临两个挑战。（一）随机性响应：即使面对相同的推荐信息流，同一用户也可能产生不同的浏览响应，从而形成不同的行为轨迹，而一条被记录的轨迹仅是其中一次可能实现的快照。（二）稀疏关键事件：点击和点赞提供了重要的反馈信号，但在以滚动等推进动作为主导的浏览轨迹中这些事件出现得较为稀疏。许多逐步式模拟器以密集序列的方式预测这些动作，导致关键事件在训练目标中所占比例相对较少。为解决这些挑战，我们提出BrowseFlow——一种用于生成式用户模拟的条件离散流匹配方法。针对稀疏关键事件，B（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出条件离散流匹配方法BrowseFlow，通过建模浏览响应的随机性和稀疏关键事件，实现更逼真的生成式用户模拟。
en_tdlr: BrowseFlow, a conditional discrete flow matching method, tackles stochastic responses and sparse key events to enable more realistic generative user simulation.
